content: Isolated pods should not force a tradeoff between security and startup performance. With classic sandboxed pod flows, every pod boots a new Kata VM, which adds cold-start latency and extra memory overhead before your app begins work. The new kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class changes that default. It creates pods from a pre-initialized sandbox VM template instead of booting each sandbox from scratch, reduces per-pod memory overhead, and uses Kata’s Rust runtime for better efficiency. You keep strong pod-level VM isolation while getting faster starts and lower runtime cost for sandboxed workloads. Learn more.
